title: Scriptorium Parsed Paper v1
description: The normalized, LOCAL parse output of one paper PDF, emitted by Steward `parse` (GROBID, with later optional rich parsers such as Docling / MinerU). A deterministic structured file — metadata + sections + reference list + figures/tables — that the read-paper skill, direction synthesis, and lineage consume as their anti-fabrication source of truth (figures/data/citations reference this file, never invented). Joined to the rest of the suite by `id` = the Better BibTeX citekey. All content arrays are OPTIONAL: a given parser may fill only a subset. Additive contract — supersedes nothing. See specs/literature-reading.md §2.

id.description: Better BibTeX citekey — the universal join id across the suite (library-kb, reading-note, lineage, project linked_literature).

created.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time when the parse was produced.

parser.description: Which local parser produced this file, e.g. "grobid" | "docling" | "mineru".

source_pdf.description: Path to the source PDF that was parsed.

metadata.description: Bibliographic metadata extracted from the PDF (best-effort; the citekey in `id` is authoritative).

sections.description: Body sections in reading order. OPTIONAL — filled when the parser extracts full text.

references.description: Parsed reference list — the edges Steward `lineage` walks for own-library lineage. OPTIONAL.

figures.description: Extracted figure descriptors (anti-fabrication: reading-note figures reference these by id). OPTIONAL.
